主要内容: Turid will leave her present administrative positions in NAT/NAO late this year. We fully respect her decision to step down. Commented the Chairman, Herbjorn Hansson: "We regret that Turid leaves the management of NAT and NAO, but we are pleased that she is a candidate for the NAT board. Going forward, we will strengthen our finance department and we plan to recruit a new CFO."
